title: security-compliance-review-prep-1on1-emily
body:
Meeting prep: 1:1 with Rajiv (security lead) - focused on SOC2/ISO readiness and vendor risk.

Goals for the call:
- Align on evidence eatery: what we already have vs what we need for SOC2 Type I/II and ISO audit.
- Prioritize immediate action items (next 30/60/90 days).
- Confirm owners and due dates for controls gaps.
- Quick status on vendor attestations and outstanding questionnaires.

Quick context notes:
- Background: We started SOC2 readiness in Q4 and kicked off control mappings. Most infra controls have owners but a few application-level controls (change management, deployment access reviews) are still thin. ISO mapping will reuse SOC2 controls where possible but need additional docs for ISMS scope and risk assessment.
- Recent changes: migrated logs to centralized logging (managed service), moved some infra to dedicated subnets for Private customers; need to capture architecture diagrams and evidence of access controls.

Agenda (30 min):
1) Quick status (5 min) - what passed, what failed in last self-assessment
2) Controls deep dive (10 min) - CC6 (change management), CC7 (incident response), Logical access (user provisioning/deprovisioning)
3) Vendor risk summary (5 min) - outstanding SIGs/SSCs/Attestations, priority vendors: LogServiceCo, SecretsManagerX, AuditStorage (S3 provider)
4) Audit readiness timeline & next steps (5 min)
5) Assign owners + confirm follow-ups (5 min)

Notes to self / talking points:
- For SOC2 evidence we need: monthly access review screenshots, RBAC role lists, IAM role -> user assignments exported, recent vuln scan report (last 30 days), patching calendar for critical infra.
- ISO: need documented risk assessment (template), statement of applicability draft, asset inventory snapshot.
- Vendor risk: chase LogServiceCo for SOC report (they promised Feb), confirm encryption at rest key management for AuditStorage (who holds keys? we use KMS customer-managed in Private deployments).
- Be explicit about sample window for auditors (typical 3-month window). Confirm our retention policy for logs and evidence (default 90 days in console, but auditors often want 12 months).

Open questions to ask Rajiv:
- Do we have a consolidated list of control owners with contact emails? (if not, I will make one)
- Which controls are we comfortable mapping to 3rd-party attestations vs in-house evidence? (e.g., managed DB encryption)
- Are there any planned infra changes in next 60 days that could affect evidence continuity?

Evidence checklist (quick):
- Architecture diagrams (updated) -> ensure Confluence page link in linked_artifacts
- Access control exports (IAM console screenshots or CSV)
- Change control tickets (Jira prefix: ENG- / SEC-), example: ENG-1423, SEC-201
- Pen test / VAPT results (last 12 months)
- Backup and restore tests (date & runbook)
- KMS key policy screenshots + audit trail

Vendor risk tracker (notes):
- LogServiceCo: have SOC2 in 2023 but need updated letter for 2024; security contact: hannah@logserviceco.com; status: awaiting SOC report (chase 2025-02-14)
- SecretsManagerX: uses centralized KMS; need confirmation on key rotation policy (ask security@secretsx)
- AuditStorage: confirm bucket policies and cross-account access; request ACL exports and last access logs

Immediate action items (during/after call):
- Emily: compile master control-owner spreadsheet and share to /security/audit/ (due 2025-02-17)
- Rajiv: follow up with LogServiceCo for SOC letter (due 2025-02-14)
follow_ups: Draft ISO risk assessment template - Hannah - 2025-02-24
